pk.context: 30 mg oral, steady state, healthy adults

pill.desc: oval, scored tablet, coloured by strength

tell: Saturable metabolism makes its steady-state exposure about eight times what single-dose data predict.

clues.text: Completely absorbed by mouth, and food slightly raises exposure. About 93% to 95% is protein bound, and it is extensively metabolized, with about 64% of a dose excreted in urine.
A hydrochloride salt whose free base has a molecular weight of 329.4. Its melting point range is 120 to 138 degrees Celsius.
An NDA tablet in 10, 20, 30 and 40 mg strengths, taken daily.
Boxed warning for suicidal thoughts and behaviors in pediatric and young adult patients. Contraindicated with MAOIs within 14 days, and with QTc-prolonging drugs that are CYP2D6 substrates.
In adults: major depressive disorder, obsessive compulsive disorder, panic disorder, social anxiety disorder, generalized anxiety disorder and PTSD.
Its action is unknown, but is presumed to come from blocking neuronal reuptake of serotonin, potentiating serotonergic activity in the CNS.
The generic name begins with P and has ten letters.
